dataset: Per-question MATH outputs of HELM Lite release v1.13.0 (Stanford CRFM), every math: run (7 subjects, level 1, chain of thought), first trial. Only subjects, instance ids, classes, routes, grades, counts and public model names are published.
note: H = HELM's is_equiv_chain_of_thought as transcribed (gated against HELM's recorded score); A = the corrected grade (grade91.py). Up-flip: H 0, A 1; down-flip: H 1, A 0. Macro accuracy = mean of the 7 subject accuracies; rank = 1 + models strictly more accurate. P2 net A - H >= 0.5% of predictions; P3 >= 100 unboxed up-flips; P4 >= 20 value_format up-flips; P5 >= 1 reference with no answer HELM can extract; P6 >= 5 models move >= 3 places; P7 5 x down-flips <= up-flips; P8 (read next run) >= 27 of 30 sampled up-flips are genuine.
